description: This file provides utility functions for managing resume uploads and deletions in Supabase Storage, including path validation, URL normalization, and interaction with the Supabase API.

methods.name: sanitizeFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by trimming, replacing invalid characters with underscores, and limiting length.

methods.name: getExtensionFromFile
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension from a File object.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type of a file, defaulting to 'application/pdf' if unknown.

methods.name: normalizeSlashes
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a string.

methods.name: stripKnownPrefix
methods.description: Removes a known prefix from a string if present.

methods.name: toBucketRelativeKey
methods.description: Converts various path or URL inputs into a bucket-relative key string.

methods.name: validateBucketRelativeKey
methods.description: Validates that a given key is a proper bucket-relative path for resume storage, considering user ID and operation context.

methods.name: mapSupabaseStorageError
methods.description: Maps Supabase storage errors to user-friendly messages, especially for invalid path errors.

methods.name: uploadOrReplaceResume
methods.description: Uploads or replaces a resume file in Supabase Storage for the current user, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: deleteResumeByPath
methods.description: Deletes a resume from Supabase Storage based on a provided path or URL, with validation and error handling.
